_how_used: tests/emergency-safety.test.ts requires every 'critical' message (development and holdout) to escalate to the emergency path, and reports the false-positive rate on 'non_emergency'. 'holdout' was written before the matcher was changed and is never used to tune it; a holdout miss found later is moved to 'development' with a note, never deleted.
